preconditions.description: The length of S is between 1 and 10^3

postconditions.description: The output is a substring of S

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[j] for i in range(len(output)) for j in range(i, len(output)))
len(output) == max(len(substring) for substring in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S))] if all(S[i] == S[j] for i in range(len(substring)) for j in range(i, len(substring))))
postconditions.description: The output is the longest palindromic substring of S

postconditions.expression: output == min(substring for substring in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S))] if all(S[i] == S[j] for i in range(len(substring)) for j in range(i, len(substring))) and len(substring) == max(len(substring) for substring in [S[i:j] for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S))] if all(S[i] == S[j] for i in range(len(substring)) for j in range(i, len(substring))))
postconditions.description: In case of conflict, the output is the substring which occurs first (with the least starting index)
